title: Ashgrove, Bandon Road, Kinsale, Co. Cork
seoTitle: Ashgrove, Bandon Road, Kinsale, Co. Cork
description:
Luma Properties Cork is delighted to present this vibrant, character-filled and exceptionally spacious home to the rental market. With an abundance of both indoor and outdoor space, this is a property with so much to offer that it is difficult to capture it all in just a few words.

On arrival, the property is approached via a large private driveway with ample parking for multiple cars, complemented by a beautifully maintained front lawn.

To the rear, you will find a generous private garden and patio area, providing a wonderful space to relax, entertain or simply enjoy the sunshine. From the far corner of the garden, you can even catch a glimpse of the harbour and passing boats, adding a lovely coastal touch to the setting.

Internally, space is certainly not in short supply. The accommodation begins with a large and welcoming entrance hallway, complete with porch and hot press storage. From here, the property opens into an impressive and highly versatile layout comprising four spacious double bedrooms and one twin bedroom, along with a main family bathroom, separate WC and two en-suite bathrooms.

The living accommodation is equally generous, featuring a large L-shaped living area, a separate dining/second living space, kitchen, utility room and a bright sunroom overlooking the garden. The variety of living spaces makes the property particularly well suited to multiple occupants, allowing everyone to enjoy both shared areas and their own sense of space and privacy.

The property is being offered on a shorter-term agreement only and, given its size, flexible layout and generous accommodation, is ideally suited to multiple occupancy.

Please contact Luma Properties Cork with your enquiry and we will endeavour to respond to as many applicants as possible.
